findings.issue: Combined acceptance checks aggregate totals and scenario count without requiring the planned job identities, per-job coverage, scenario identities, or complete statistical fields. Empty paired/events dictionaries satisfy the precision loops. The enclosed complete() fixture illustrates this acceptance gap structurally. The assessment also does not revalidate receipt hashes or bind the selected supplement to the native invocation whose outcome is being assessed.
findings.why_it_matters: An incomplete, stale, or unrelated report can satisfy the aggregate checks and receive PASS. A failed native retry can leave older analysis/verification.json and verification.yaml available for --assess.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: In analysis/, validate assessment inputs against the exact protocol inventory, per-job row/replay counts, required scenario metrics, and current evidence hashes. Require an explicitly selected native invocation receipt and validate VerificationItems before combining them. Add corruption cases for empty summaries, redistributed job totals, wrong scenario identities, and a failed retry following an older PASS.

findings.location: analysis/supplement/checker.py: combined_assessment precision loop; independent.py: Moments.summary
findings.issue: Deterministic scenarios enter the relative-precision loop despite their required absence of statistical CIs. Their nonempty Moments summaries have precision_met=false, so all three deterministic paired metrics are added to failed_precision.
findings.why_it_matters: The approved deterministic repetitions are deliberately excluded from statistical precision requirements. The assessment reports an artificial precision failure independently of the legitimate retained boundary uncertainty.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: Exclude deterministic scenarios from statistical precision assessment in analysis/. Preserve their absolute residual checks and undefined CIs. Add a combined-assessment test containing a real-shaped deterministic summary with a positive paired denominator and no CI.

findings.location: analysis/supplement/checker.py: source_snapshot, input_snapshot, execute finally, execute_lineage_recipe finally
findings.issue: The final source comparison covers only supplemental Python files. It does not recheck the full 19-source review binding, including the pinned oracle, native verifier, framework verification source, and schema. Final input comparison also reuses the original manifest list rather than detecting additions or removals in the inventory.
findings.why_it_matters: source_bindings_rechecked can be true despite changes to reviewed dependencies used during execution. Newly added manifests are outside the final comparison, weakening the claimed inventory stability.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: In analysis/, retain and recheck the complete reviewed-source mapping and exact manifest-path set at completion. Include the dependencies needed by lineage replay. Add tests changing a pinned dependency and adding a manifest between initial and final checks.

findings.issue: The native acceptance route raises an error when statistical-precision is false. run_native converts that rejection into FAIL, and combined_assessment treats every non-PASS native status as scientific failure with implementation-bug triage. This conflates insufficient precision or incomplete execution with an independently established implementation contradiction.
findings.why_it_matters: The protocol requires insufficient precision to remain inconclusive. A clean numerical audit with an unmet precision target must not become an implementation-bug finding solely because the legacy native acceptance route rejected it.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: In analysis/, retain the native acceptance outcome separately and derive scientific FAIL versus INCONCLUSIVE from structured failure reasons and independently checked evidence. Preserve rejection of unsupported gate requests. Test native precision rejection and timeout separately from actual constraint or recomputation failures. Any native source change requires PI handling.

findings.location: analysis/supplement/checker.py: execute finally and execute_lineage_recipe finally
findings.issue: Final binding rechecks run without budget checkpoints. execute records runtime_s and finished before those rechecks; lineage records finished without a final deadline check.
findings.why_it_matters: Completion hashing can exceed the cooperative deadline without changing a successful status, and the execution duration excludes part of the verification work.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: Keep final rechecks within cooperative budget accounting, retain a receipt when the deadline is exceeded, and record completion timestamps and elapsed time after final checks. Add a delayed-final-recheck fixture.

findings.location: analysis/supplement/run_unit_tests.py: subprocess invocation and JUnit parsing
findings.issue: The unit runner has no exception-safe receipt path around subprocess timeout or missing/malformed JUnit output. Those failures occur before stdout/stderr and receipt creation.
findings.why_it_matters: A failed preparation check can leave a directory without an explanatory receipt, contrary to the intended retained-failure evidence policy.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: Add an analysis-only try/finally receipt path retaining timeout output, exception details, exit status, and available evidence even when JUnit parsing fails. Test timeout and missing-JUnit cases without canonical execution.
